integrity: Theorem derived from explicit local adjacency tests, complete 64-state finite transition analysis, and all-length path classification; supporting verification code is supplied. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Open two-row ladders only, at least two columns; no classification of circular/wider ladders. Full text of the motivating 2026 general algorithm preprint unavailable during comparison; historical priority remains subject to broader examination.
title: Perfect edge domination is rigid on open ladders
